decisions.reason: The encrypted secondary channel is part of the firm's announced security direction and fits with its core architecture, so management will likely keep it, though its modest visibility (only mentioned, never given its own page) leaves some risk of quiet removal.

The multi-layer end-to-end security architecture received its own page in 2019 and is central to the firm's publicly stated positioning, so sunk investment and public commitment strongly favor keeping it.

The QR-code hardware signature token was upgraded to its own page and involved hardware investment, so management is likely to attribute any weak sales to temporary market adoption issues and persist with it.

The payment network compliance suite was only mentioned and is more peripheral, but compliance demand is recurring and the firm has already invested in it, so it will probably be kept despite moderate drop risk.
